host.intro: During some months of the year, sargassum can affect the beaches. But Tulum has SO MANY amazing alternatives: cenotes, lagoons, ruins, and nightlife. This guide has my personal recommendations so you can make the most of your stay.
host.note: Prices are approximate and may vary by season. I recommend carrying cash.

sections.cenotes_desc: Crystal-clear natural pools, perfect when the sea has sargassum. Most open 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM.
sections.lagunas_desc: Calm waters with no sargassum, perfect for a relaxing day.
sections.parques_desc: Adventure and nature in the Riviera Maya.
sections.nightlife_desc: Parties and the best vibes in Tulum.
sections.restaurantes_desc: Our favorite picks near the condo.
sections.bares_desc: For cocktails in a special atmosphere.
sections.locales_desc: In downtown Tulum, authentic and affordable options.

tips.title: Key Tips
items: During sargassum season, cenotes and lagoons are your best bet
Go early (8-10 AM) to avoid crowds
Carry cash (many places don't accept cards)
Rent a car, bicycle, or scooter to get around

footer.text: Made with love from Aldea Zama, Tulum
